objective_checks.detail: changing docs/guide.md routes as expected across 3 workflow(s)
changing src/index.js routes as expected across 3 workflow(s)
changing package-lock.json routes as expected across 3 workflow(s)
changing README.md, LICENSE routes as expected across 3 workflow(s)
required check(s) always fire and gate internally (.github/workflows/tests.yml)
event-only workflows carry no path filters (.github/workflows/nightly-sweep.yml, .github/workflows/triage.yml)

dimensions.name: Completeness
dimensions.rationale: Every pull_request/push workflow received a deliberate decision, and the required `unit-tests` check got exactly the correct shape — one workflow with no workflow-level paths/paths-ignore, gating the job via a computed `changes` output and `if:`, with no companion skip workflow duplicating the check name.

dimensions.name: Salience
dimensions.rationale: Each workflow's paths list matches what its own steps actually consume (tests.yml: src/test/deps/self; deploy.yml: src/deps/deploy.sh/self per its comment; docs-site.yml: docs/mkdocs.yml/self), with no catch-alls or copied sibling lists.

dimensions.name: Restraint
dimensions.rationale: The schedule-only (nightly-sweep) and issue-driven (triage) workflows and the branch-protection ruleset were left untouched, and no files outside the audit scope were edited.
